title: Quantum Machine Learning for Signature Forgery Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.33163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline handwritten signatures remain a primary behavioural biometric in legal and financial documents. Detecting skilled forgeries from a static raster image is hard because pen pressure, timing and stroke order are missing. This work studies a family of quantum machine learning pipelines for offline signature forgery detection on a public Kaggle corpus of images split into two classes. We pair a ZZ feature map quantum kernel with three classical learners: K-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest. We then propose a deeper hybrid that uses EfficientNetB0 as a frozen feature extractor, reduces the resulting 1280 dimensional representation to a qubit register sized subspace through a quantum compatible principal component projection and decides class membership with a nearest neighbour rule. translated_title: 面向签名伪造检测的量子机器学习
translated_abstract: 离线手写签名仍然是法律和金融文件中主要的行为生物特征识别手段。由于笔压、书写时序和笔画顺序等信息的缺失，从静态光栅图像中检测高仿真伪造签名十分困难。本工作在公开的 Kaggle 图像语料库上研究了用于离线签名伪造检测的一系列量子机器学习流水线，该语料库的图像被划分为两个类别。我们将 ZZ 特征映射量子核与三种经典学习器相结合：K近邻、支持向量机和随机森林。随后，我们提出了一种更深层的混合模型，该模型使用 EfficientNetB0 作为冻结特征提取器，通过量子兼容的主成分投影将所得的 1280 维表示降维到与量子比特寄存器规模相匹配的子空间，并采用最近邻规则判定类别归属。在单一留出测试折上，所提出的混合模型达到了 92.62% 的准确率。在分层五折交叉验证上……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将冻结的 EfficientNetB0 特征提取器与量子兼容主成分投影及最近邻决策相结合的混合量子机器学习流水线，用于离线手写签名伪造检测，达到 92.62% 的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid quantum machine learning pipeline that combines a frozen EfficientNetB0 feature extractor with quantum-compatible principal component projection and a nearest-neighbor rule for offline signature forgery detection, achieving 92.62% accuracy.
